role: First large-format Moonpet bot character art pass.

visual_direction.pet: large cyber pet/bot with black visor, hot-pink LED face, backwards cap, headphones, graffiti jacket, spray cans and oversized street sneakers
visual_direction.background: night rooftop cyber city, purple/blue neon, wet floor reflections, graffiti marks and moon skyline

action_states.description: Default large bot pet stance with neon rooftop background and trait chips.
Food bowl, snack sparks and warm energy state.
Hover ball, jump movement and arcade motion.
Bubbles, wash streaks and fresh visor treatment.
Dimmed night state, Z symbols, blanket panel and sleepy LED eyes.
Spray-can power-up, neon slash marks and training energy.

runtime_notes: Loaded by moonpet-game.html after the existing Moonpet Mini App runtime.
Uses a transparent overlay canvas so current gameplay code, controls, API state and HUD remain intact.
Action mode is inferred from clicked controls and terminal text, then mapped to the matching art state.
This is the first pet pass; follow-up pets should get their own species-specific renderer and manifest entry.
